sentence: The room's organizing can be restated in the model's terms—calls, design, upkeep, cross-school help, and close reflection—and none of the unused concepts shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts.

UVic's organizing restates in the model's terms (calls and defense [P01/P05/P09], design and template work [P02/P04], west-coast help and coalition [P16/P17], scripted upkeep [P14], and post-close marking, recording and contest talk [P11/P12/P18]), and none of the unused concepts in t01-t05 shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts.
